technical.summary: Overbought short-term momentum with bullish structure conflicts with bearish intermediate/long-term positioning and weak trend strength; high risk of pullback despite three white soldiers pattern.

fundamental.summary: PLD shows minimal fundamental signals with no insider activity, institutional positioning, government contracts, lobbying spend, or retail interest as of 2022-07-05.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and stale with no recent conviction buying from senior members.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (361), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and negative macro score (-4) create severe headwinds for real estate; avoid or hedge aggressively.

debate.key_bull_argument: Overbought RSI(9) with golden cross SMA(9/21) and extreme market fear (27/100) create contrarian buy setup near support at 105.14, offering asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price is below all major moving averages (EMA50, SMA50, SMA200), VIX crisis (361), rising credit spreads, strong dollar headwind, and weak trend strength (ADX) make this a high-probability pullback trap despite short-term overbought conditions.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme market fear and overbought RSI(9) create contrarian setup, but price is decisively below all major moving averages with weak trend strength, signaling high pullback risk in a macro crisis environment.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (361) and rising credit spreads in real estate sector create severe macro headwinds; price likely to test lower support as fear-driven bounce fails.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, risk, and debate agents all favor bear case; only sentiment offers contrarian angle
